name: loki
description: Grafana Loki log aggregation and LogQL query language. Covers LogQL syntax (log queries, metric queries, label matchers, line filters, parsers: json/logfmt/pattern/regexp/unpack, label filters, line_format), Loki architecture, log ingestion via Alloy/Promtail/Fluent Bit, structured metadata, and Logs Drilldown. Use when writing LogQL queries, configuring Loki, troubleshooting log pipelines, or analyzing logs.
